spec.overview: This document outlines the product specification for 'Test', a software application designed for comprehensive software testing. 'Test' aims to provide a unified platform for various testing methodologies, including unit testing, integration testing, system testing, and user acceptance testing. The goal is to improve software quality, reduce bugs, and accelerate the software development lifecycle (SDLC). 'Test' will offer features for test case management, automated test execution, reporting, and integration with popular CI/CD tools. Its modular design will support future extensions with minimal disruption.
features: Test Case Management: Allows users to create, organize, and manage test cases with detailed steps, expected results, and associated data.
Automated Test Execution: Supports automated execution of various types of tests, including unit tests, integration tests, and API tests.
Test Scripting: Provides a user-friendly interface or API for writing and managing test scripts in multiple languages (e.g., Python, Java, JavaScript).
Reporting and Analytics: Generates comprehensive reports on test results, including pass/fail rates, execution times, and defect tracking integration.
CI/CD Integration: Integrates seamlessly with popular CI/CD tools like Jenkins, GitLab CI, and CircleCI to automate testing as part of the deployment pipeline.
Defect Tracking Integration: Connects with bug tracking systems like Jira and Bugzilla to facilitate defect reporting and resolution.
Environment Configuration: Enables users to configure test environments with different operating systems, browsers, and databases.
Role-Based Access Control (RBAC): Provides granular control over user access and permissions for test case management and execution.
Scalability: Designed to handle a large number of test cases and concurrent users.
API Support: Offers a comprehensive API for integration with other systems and custom test tools.
Test Data Management: Facilitates the creation and management of test data, ensuring consistency and accuracy during testing.
Parallel Test Execution: Supports parallel execution of tests to reduce overall testing time.
techStack: Backend Framework: Django or Flask (Python), Spring Boot (Java)
Frontend Framework: React, Angular, or Vue.js
CI/CD Tools: Jenkins, GitLab CI, CircleCI
Cloud Platform: AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP)

steps.title: Unit Test: Test Case Management - Create Test Case
steps.command: Write unit tests for the Test Case Management module to ensure the creation of test cases with valid data (title, description, steps, expected results). Handle edge cases like missing data or invalid input types.

steps.title: Implementation: Test Case Management - Create Test Case
steps.command: Implement the functionality for creating test cases in the Test Case Management module. This includes defining the data model for a test case and writing the code to persist test cases to the database. Validate user input to ensure data integrity.

steps.title: Unit Test: Test Case Management - Retrieve Test Case
steps.command: Write unit tests to verify the retrieval of test cases by ID. Ensure correct data retrieval and handle cases where the test case does not exist.

steps.title: Implementation: Test Case Management - Retrieve Test Case
steps.command: Implement the functionality to retrieve a test case by its ID from the database. Implement error handling for non-existent test cases.

steps.title: Unit Test: Test Case Management - Update Test Case
steps.command: Write unit tests for updating test cases. Ensure that updates are correctly applied and handle scenarios where the test case does not exist or the update data is invalid.

steps.title: Implementation: Test Case Management - Update Test Case
steps.command: Implement the functionality to update existing test cases in the database. Include validation of updated data and error handling.

steps.title: Unit Test: Test Case Management - Delete Test Case
steps.command: Write unit tests for deleting test cases. Verify that the deletion is successful and handle cases where the test case does not exist.

steps.title: Implementation: Test Case Management - Delete Test Case
steps.command: Implement the functionality to delete a test case from the database. Handle cases where the test case does not exist gracefully.

steps.title: Unit Test: Automated Test Execution - Execute Unit Tests
steps.command: Write unit tests to verify that automated test execution can successfully run unit tests (e.g., using Pytest, JUnit, or Jest). Ensure that results are correctly captured.

steps.title: Implementation: Automated Test Execution - Execute Unit Tests
steps.command: Implement the core logic for executing unit tests. This will involve integrating with testing frameworks like Pytest, JUnit or Jest, and capturing test results.

steps.title: Unit Test: Automated Test Execution - Execute API Tests
steps.command: Write unit tests for executing API tests. Verify that API endpoints can be tested and results are accurately recorded.

steps.title: Implementation: Automated Test Execution - Execute API Tests
steps.command: Implement functionality for running API tests, potentially using libraries like Requests (Python) or equivalent libraries in Java or JavaScript. Capture results and errors.

steps.title: Unit Test: Reporting and Analytics - Generate Basic Report
steps.command: Write unit tests for generating basic test reports (pass/fail rates, execution times). Verify that the report data is accurate.

steps.title: Implementation: Reporting and Analytics - Generate Basic Report
steps.command: Implement the functionality to generate basic test reports. This includes calculating pass/fail rates and execution times, and formatting the data into a readable report.

steps.title: Unit Test: CI/CD Integration - Trigger Test Run
steps.command: Write unit tests for the CI/CD integration module to simulate triggering a test run from a CI/CD tool. Validate parameters passed to the test execution module.

steps.title: Implementation: CI/CD Integration - Trigger Test Run
steps.command: Implement the functionality to receive trigger requests from CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitLab CI) and initiate test runs. Parse parameters from the CI/CD tool and pass them to the test execution module.
